question: What year was the Eiffel Tower completed, and who designed it?

candidates.answer: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 and was designed by the French engineer Gustave Eiffel【https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eiffel_Tower】.
candidates.label: A

candidates.answer: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889. It was designed by the engineering firm of Gustave Eiffel, with the structural design led by Maurice Koechlin and Émile Nouguier, and the architectural appearance refined by Stephen Sauvestre.
candidates.label: B

candidates.answer: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 and was designed by Gustave Eiffel, with engineering contributions from Maurice Koechlin and Émile Nouguier.
